messages:
maria_sales: Hi team — POC with AcmeHealth hitting intermittent 502/ECONNRESET when streaming through their corp proxy. Customer says streaming cuts out after ~30s and client retries spike leading to 429s from our hosted API :grimacing:

alex_se: Can you paste logs + client config? Are they using our TS SDK behind a corporate proxy or a gateway?

maria_sales: Yep TS SDK via company proxy (ZScaler). Logs: ```[2026-03-18T17:12:03Z] stream: error ECONNRESET
[2026-03-18T17:12:03Z] response: 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-03-18T17:12:04Z] retries: 4 -> 429``` Client snippet:
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, timeout: 30000 });
``` 

sam_sdk: @maria_sales common issue — proxy kills idle socket, TS SDK needs a persistent agent and reduced aggressive retries. Suggest:
```ts
import https from 'https';
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 10 });
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey, timeout: 45000, agent });
```
Also set retry backoff: exponential + jitter and cap retries to 2.

alex_se: For Python POC add Session with HTTPAdapter and set pool_connections/pool_maxsize and keepalive via urllib3. Also have them whitelist our endpoints in PAC file / bypass proxy for *.redwood.ai

irene_customer: We're nervous about rate limits — what's the quick mitigation? If retries cause 429s we get throttled and POC looks bad.

maria_sales: Two options: 1) short-term: lower client retries and add backoff + ask customer to bypass proxy for redwood endpoints. 2) mid-term: offer Dedicated pool / reserved capacity for POC (reduces throttling, can raise throughput). Pricing note: trial Dedicated is possible for 30d — I can get terms.

devops_bot: Support ticket created: S-24781 — eng-runtime oncall assigned.

alex_se: @eng_runtime can you check if our edge sees repeated conn resets from that customer IP block? If so we can disable aggressive rate-limiting for this POC IP range.

eng_runtime: Looking. I see spikes from 3 IPs in that block with many quick reconnects. Temporarily raising rate limit window for that IPs and adding 1s server-side retry debounce. Will monitor.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll coordinate with Irene and send them the agent code change + the support ticket link. :thumbsup:
